status: draft (not frozen): to be checked against the source and frozen by the author before any run on real data
title: Sink-OFCs and conduit-OFCs in Garcia-Bernardo and others (2017)
source: Javier Garcia-Bernardo, Jan Fichtner, Frank W Takes and Eelke M Heemskerk, 'Uncovering Offshore Financial Centers: Conduits and Sinks in the Global Corporate Ownership Network' (2017) 7 Scientific Reports 6246, Table 1 and p 6
transcription: Sink list from Table 1 via automated extraction of the open-access version (Leiden University repository), ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes converted to alpha-3; conduit list quoted from p 6. Check against the published table before freezing.
data_requirement: Orbis global ownership (the source used 2015 data) with operating revenue; GDP for the same year; ISO alpha-3 identifiers.
